findings.finding: Earlier editions depended on labels to identify spatial safety and restoration.
findings.remediation: Rebuild S7 as public cross, one-side trial bay, evidence porch and blue-green edge.
findings.verification: V7/V8 four-scale drawings locate routes, curb, posts, E-stops, fire and removal paths.

findings.finding: V6 A0 principal images were approximately 34–38 ppi.
findings.remediation: Generate native A0 vector pages and retain vector text and linework.
findings.verification: Both V8 A0 PDFs are native 1189×841 mm, three pages and below 6 MiB; 150 dpi contact sheets show no crop or overlap.

findings.finding: Active records retained old-version design references.
findings.remediation: Resolve all active design references against current GeoJSON.
findings.verification: V8 automated QA resolves 98/98 active V7-D references and finds zero active V5-D references.

findings.finding: V6 lacked a reproducible kit and operating day.
findings.remediation: Add quantities, ownership, quote status, daily operation and recovery clock.
findings.verification: V8 retains 17 reproducible quantity rules, maintenance/retirement roles and a six-step operating day; prices remain pending.

findings.finding: V7 Agent 4–6 evidence did not independently establish landmarks, culture, developer activity or annual operation.
findings.remediation: Create three receipt landmarks, a civic evidence mile, four-season programme and unique task evidence.
findings.verification: Chinese and English proposals, matrices, atlas and reports now give Agent 1–6 distinct chapters, figures, data and conclusions.

findings.finding: V7 core figures repeated the same cross plan and culture-brand duplicated ecosystem-synergy byte-for-byte.
findings.remediation: Assign one decision to each canonical figure and rebuild the optional figures with distinct content.
findings.verification: V8 hash QA finds no duplicate across eight Chinese or eight English review figures; all five canonical figures were inspected at 1024 px.

findings.finding: V7 quantities lacked a compact sequence connecting verification, baseline, trial, recovery and public receipt.
findings.remediation: Publish five-gate S7 90-day protocol with role separation.
findings.verification: Schema 1.6.0 and bilingual publications show five day ranges with gates, outputs and failure conditions.

findings.finding: A3 opening page underused the strongest spatial evidence and A0/A3 information roles overlapped.
findings.remediation: Place all three landmark silhouettes and the flagship section on A3 page 1; assign distinct page and board questions.
findings.verification: Four bilingual PDFs were rendered at 150 dpi and inspected; page counts are A0 3 and A3 16.

findings.finding: Landmark, annual programme and pilot objects could become display-only claims without stable links.
findings.remediation: Link landmarks to stations, components and scenarios; link seasons and pilot phases to evidence outputs.
findings.verification: qa-v8.js passes schema 1.6.0, 3/3 landmarks, 4/4 seasons, 5/5 phases, 12/12 scenarios and all references.

findings.finding: New V8 claims risked drifting between Chinese and English deliverables.
findings.remediation: Generate paired figures/PDFs and inject both HTML languages from the same V8 data.
findings.verification: Figure positions, IDs, counts, page counts, schema and evidence states correspond in both languages.

findings.finding: Official survey, ownership, statutory controls, utilities and observed flows remain unavailable.
findings.remediation: Keep concept-scale disclosures and require these inputs before E2.

findings.finding: No scene has been field-run, so thresholds and adoption decisions remain unavailable.
findings.remediation: Keep performance unknown and advance only through E0–E4 after field baseline establishment.

findings.finding: Dazhongsi OSM context contains only one confirmed building feature.
findings.remediation: Show public-data-missing zones and distinguish design envelopes from context.

findings.finding: Official station exits and precise transport interfaces remain unavailable.
findings.remediation: Use directional interfaces only and verify before E2.

findings.finding: The in-app browser policy rejected direct file:// navigation, so four HTML first-viewport screenshots and runtime interaction checks are not yet captured for the 18-image blind-review pack.
findings.remediation: Open the local report and exhibition in the user browser, then verify desktop, mobile, keyboard, state/hash restoration, reduced motion and zero network requests before Ready PR.

note: Content and publication major findings are closed with reproducible evidence. Ready PR remains held until browser runtime and the complete 18-image blind review are performed; no score is self-authored.
